Counsel for Petitioner :- Anurag Narain,Shailendra Kumar Misra Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.
Hon'ble Alok Singh,J.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and Shri S.B.Pandey, learned A.S.G. assisted by Shri Varun Pandey for Union of India.

On 2.11.2020 following order has been passed by this court:-
"Heard Sri Anuraj Narain, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri S.B. Pandey,
learned Assistant Solicitor General of India assisted by Sri Raj Kumar Singh, learned counsel for opposite parties and perused the record.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that respondent no.3 does not have any power or authority to issue impugned advisories which have an effect of amending Regulations which ought to have been framed under Section 92 of the Food Safety Kcg Oil & Food Pvt. Ltd.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that respondent no.3 does not have any power or authority to issue impugned advisories which have an effect of amending Regulations which ought to have been framed under Section 92 of the Food Safety Kcg Oil & Food Pvt. Ltd.
When the matter is taken up today learned counsel for the petitioner submits that statement has been given by learned counsel appearing for Union of India before Delhi High Court that notification dated 23.9.2020 has been withdrawn by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The learned counsels for the respondent(s) submit that by the Notification dated 10.11.2020, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has initiated the consultation process under Section 92 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
They further submit, on instructions,
that the Impugned Notification/Direction dated 23.09.2020 has been withdrawn by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.
All consequent orders issued thereon be also treated as withdrawn.
In view of the above, the petitions stand satisfied and are disposed of recording the above statement."
In view of the aforesaid, the petition is disposed of.
